title: Static web page
description: A static web page, sometimes called a flat page or a stationary page, is a web page that is delivered to a web browser exactly as stored,[1] in contrast to dynamic web pages which are generated by a web application.[2]

title: HTTP
description: HTTP is an application layer protocol in the Internet protocol suite for distributed, collaborative, hypermedia information systems. HTTP is the foundation of data communication for the World Wide Web, where hypertext documents include hyperlinks to other resources that the user can easily access, for example by a mouse click or by tapping the screen in a web browser.
